# Retrieve the previously cached attraction search results for St. Louis
attractions_cache_key = "attractions_st_louis_touristy"
attractions_results = get_results_from_cache(key=attractions_cache_key)

# Search for hotels in St. Louis with specified criteria
hotel_search = search_hotels(
    city="St. Louis",
    checkin_date=["2025-08-03"],
    checkout_date=["2025-08-11"],
    num_people=4,
    stars=[5],
    budget=70,
    pool_present=True,
    has_room_service=True
)

# Save the hotel search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="hotels_st_louis_5_star_pool_room_service", value=hotel_search)

# Find the nearest tourist attractions to the hotel
nearest_attractions = search_nearest(
    hotels=hotel_search,
    attractions=attractions_results,
    groupBy="attraction"
)

# Save the nearest attractions results to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_attractions_st_louis", value=nearest_attractions)

# Output summary to user
print("No planning needed")
